description: Compute a short-term trend on aqi_uk using a lightweight 3-point slope or last-value vs previous-mean comparison and label as rising/falling/steady.

result_summary.name: short_term_trend_label
result_summary.description: Trend based on last value vs mean of previous values in window. Threshold=0.3 AQI units.

result_summary.name: previous_mean
result_summary.description: Mean of previous values in the short window.

result_summary.name: window_span_minutes
result_summary.description: Time span covered by the short-term window.

result_summary.name: slope_per_hour
result_summary.description: Estimated linear slope across window (AQI units per hour).

result_summary.name: rolling_rising_windows
result_summary.description: Count of rising 3-point windows across series.

result_summary.name: rolling_falling_windows
result_summary.description: Count of falling 3-point windows across series.

result_summary.name: rolling_steady_windows
result_summary.description: Count of steady 3-point windows across series.
